sentences.zh: 回来之后，丹妮拉开始在 P.F.

sentences.zh: 当丹妮拉告诉她自己没有车，因为泰勒之前把车撞坏了

sentences.zh: 丹妮拉乐意至极地给予了帮助。

sentences.zh: 2018年6月6日，丹妮拉生下一个男婴。

sentences.zh: 养父母陪她经历了生产过程，她让他们剪断了脐带，希望这能帮助这个新家庭迅速建立纽带。

sentences.en: Despite reassuring Julie that she was in good health, Daniela had experienced complications during labour that continued after she left the hospital.

sentences.zh: 她感到剧烈疼痛，并且出血严重。

sentences.en: But three days after the birth, Daniela returned to work.
sentences.zh: 但在孩子出生三天后，丹妮拉就重返工作岗位了。

sentences.en: Determined to save money, she pushed herself hard and didn't give herself time to heal.
sentences.zh: 为了省钱，她拼命工作，没有给自己留出康复的时间。

sentences.en: Instead, she relied on Norco, a strong prescription painkiller similar to the better-known Vicodin, which can cause drowsiness.

sentences.en: Her main priority was buying a car, as she didn't like being reliant on friends and Tyler's family to drive her around

sentences.en: On June 17, less than two weeks after giving birth, Daniela wrote a list of goals in her journal, using fancy writing and illustrating the page with tattoo-style pictures

sentences.en: She had successfully saved up enough money to place a down payment on a car and was taking the necessary steps to secure the one she wanted

sentences.en: Her dreams and goals for what came next related mostly to Cora
sentences.zh: 她对接下来生活的梦想和目标主要都与科拉有关

sentences.en: Daniela wrote that she wanted to get Cora's bedroom together take her to school every day get her involved with a sport or dance and have Cora sleep over 80% of the time.
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉写道，她想把科拉的卧室收拾好，每天接送她上学，让她参加一项运动或舞蹈，并让科拉有80%以上的时间跟自己一起过夜。

sentences.en: Buy here, pay here dealers often provide on-site financing options for those who are unable to get credit elsewhere, offering loans with higher interest rates
sentences.zh: 购车即贷车行为那些无法在别处获得信用贷款的人提供现场融资选择，提供利率更高的贷款

sentences.en: The loan comes directly from the dealer, who will often stipulate that the repayments have to be made in person, in cash
sentences.zh: 贷款直接来自车商，车商通常会规定必须亲自以现金形式偿还分期付款

sentences.en: The car Daniela wanted was worth around $10,000, which required a down payment of $1,500
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉想要的车价值约10,000美元，需要支付1,500美元的首付

sentences.en: Pearl Motors agreed to let her pay $1,000 of the down payment in cash with the remaining $500 to be paid by the end of the month
sentences.zh: 珍珠汽车行同意让她用现金支付1,000美元首付，剩下的500美元在月底前付清

sentences.en: However, she had to pay for her insurance via a bank transfer which was a problem as Daniela's bank account was overdrawn
sentences.zh: 然而，她必须通过银行转账支付保险费，这成了一个问题，因为丹妮拉的银行账户透支了

sentences.en: She didn't have enough money to pay the full amount owed to her overdrawn account as well as her insurance, so she decided to deposit the cash into Julie's
sentences.zh: 她没有足够的钱既付清透支账户所欠的全款，又支付保险，于是她决定将现金存入朱莉的

sentences.en: account, from which the insurance would then be paid.
sentences.zh: 账户，然后从该账户中支付保险费。

sentences.en: Pearl Motors required a number of documents from Daniela, including a letter of recommendation from her landlord stating she was reliable in paying her rent.
sentences.zh: 珍珠汽车行需要丹妮拉提供多份文件，其中包括房东的一封推荐信，证明她支付房租很可靠。

sentences.en: She borrowed Julie's car and spent the day going back and forth getting all of the paperwork together so that she could pick up the car the next day.
sentences.zh: 她借了朱莉的车，花了一整天时间来回奔波，把所有的文件都凑齐，以便第二天去提车。

sentences.en: When she finally got everything sorted, she returned the car to Julie's house in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 当她终于把一切都弄妥后，她在下午把车还到了朱莉家。

sentences.en: It was just six weeks since she had given birth and she was exhausted and still in pain.
sentences.zh: 此时距离她分娩刚过去六周，她筋疲力尽，而且依然疼痛。

sentences.en: Daniela lay down on the couch and took her painkillers.
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉躺在沙发上，吃了止痛药。

sentences.en: She was staying at Julie's that night.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上她住在朱莉家。

sentences.zh: 第二天，朱莉打算开车送丹妮拉去银行，然后再去珍珠汽车行提车。

sentences.zh: 一旦丹妮拉拿到车，她就想去给科拉买一些学习用品，包括小女孩之前赞不绝口的一款扎染双肩包。

sentences.en: After that, Daniela planned to meet up with some friends and go out for a celebratory drink.

sentences.zh: 周四，当科拉和家里其他人预定回来的时候，

sentences.en: Daniela would return to Julie's to surprise her daughter with the backpack and stay overnight so they could cuddle up together.
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉将回到朱莉家，用双肩包给女儿一个惊喜，并留宿一晚，这样他们就可以依偎在一起了。

sentences.en: As they discussed their plans, Daniela barely moved.
sentences.zh: 在讨论计划时，丹妮拉几乎一动不动。

sentences.en: She apologised to Julie for being so tired, saying,
sentences.zh: 她为自己这么累向朱莉道歉，说道：

sentences.en: This medicine just makes me really sleepy.
sentences.zh: 这药真让人犯困。

sentences.en: On the morning of Tuesday July 17 2018, Daniela rose early
sentences.zh: 2018年7月17日星期二早晨，丹妮拉很早就起了床

sentences.en: All of the paperwork required to finalise her car purchase was in a large envelope that she shoved into her large, satchel-type handbag
sentences.zh: 办妥购车手续所需的所有文件都装在一个大信封里，她把信封塞进了她那只大的大号手提包里

sentences.en: Julie then drove Daniela to the bank as planned so she could deposit cash into Julie's account to pay for her car insurance
sentences.zh: 随后，朱莉按计划开车送丹妮拉去了银行，以便她能将现金存入朱莉的账户来支付车险

sentences.en: Just after 11am, Julie dropped Daniela off at Pearl Motors and waited out the front as she signed the paperwork and picked up the keys
sentences.zh: 上午11点刚过，朱莉把丹妮拉送到珍珠汽车行，并在门外等候，而丹妮拉则在里面签署文件并拿走了钥匙

sentences.en: Ten minutes later, Daniela finally sat in her Chevy Cruze and got the final rundown on its features
sentences.zh: 十分钟后，丹妮拉终于坐进她的雪佛兰克鲁兹，并了解了这辆车的各项功能说明。

sentences.en: These included a global positioning system, or GPS, that would be attached to the car to track all of Daniela's movements until the car had been paid off.
sentences.zh: 其中包括一个全球定位系统（即 GPS），它将被安装在车上，用于追踪丹妮拉的所有行踪，直到车贷还清为止。

sentences.en: This was designed to make repossession of the car easier if a buyer failed to make their repayments.
sentences.zh: 这是为了在买家未能按时还款时，能够更轻松地将车辆收回。

sentences.en: The GPS plugged into a port under the steering column and would ping the car's location every four minutes when it was in motion and every
sentences.zh: 该 GPS 插在方向盘下方的接口上，汽车行驶时每四分钟发送一次位置信号，当车辆闲置时则

sentences.en: four hours when the vehicle wasn't in use.
sentences.zh: 每四小时发送一次。

sentences.en: If it became disconnected, the company would receive an alert and would go in search of the car.
sentences.zh: 如果设备被拔掉，公司将收到警报并会去寻找这辆车。

sentences.en: Daniela had signed an acknowledgement that the GPS was there and that she would not attempt to remove it.
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉已经签署了一份确认书，承认车上装有 GPS，并且她不会试图将其拆除。

sentences.en: At 11.35am, Julie waved Daniela off as she left the car yard.
sentences.zh: 上午 11 点 35 分，朱莉挥手送别离开车场的丹妮拉。

sentences.en: From there, Daniela drove the 24-minute journey to her home at the 701 South
sentences.zh: 随后，丹妮拉驾车行驶了 24 分钟，回到位于大学大道 701 号南公寓

sentences.en: Apartments complex on University Boulevard.
sentences.zh: 群落的家中。

sentences.en: She hadn't been going out lately, but was determined to celebrate her new purchase.
sentences.zh: 她最近一直没有出门，但她决心好好庆祝一下自己刚买的新车。

sentences.en: Although it was a Tuesday, Daniela was optimistic she would find someone willing to go out for a few drinks, as most of her friends worked in the hospitality industry.
sentences.zh: 虽然是星期二，但丹妮拉乐观地认为她能找到愿意一起出去喝几杯的人，因为她的朋友大多在酒店餐饮业工作。

sentences.en: In addition, the 89th Major League Baseball All-Star Game was on that night and would be televised live, making it more likely that people would be out and about.
sentences.zh: 此外，当晚正值美国职业棒球大联盟第 89 届全明星赛并进行现场直播，这使得人们外出活动的可能性大大增加。

sentences.en: Mobile was a baseball mad city, having produced more baseball Hall of Famers than any other city in the US outside of New York and Chicago.
sentences.zh: 莫比尔是一座对棒球痴迷的城市，除了纽约和芝加哥之外，这里出的棒球名人堂成员比美国其他任何城市都多。

sentences.en: Daniela remained at home for several hours and in the afternoon, she started making plans for the evening.
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉在家呆了几个小时，到了下午，她开始筹划晚上的安排。

sentences.en: Just before 4.20pm, she texted her friend and co-worker Hannah to ask if she was at work as Daniela was thinking of heading over to the mall where P.F.
sentences.zh: 下午 4 点 20 分前不久，她给朋友兼同事汉娜发短信，问她是否在上班，因为丹妮拉正考虑去

sentences.en: Chang's was located to buy Cora's school supplies.
sentences.zh: P.F. Chang's 餐厅所在的购物中心为科拉买学习用品。

sentences.en: Hannah responded that she would be starting work at 5 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 汉娜回复说她五点钟开始上班。

sentences.en: A few minutes later, Daniela sent a Facebook message to Randy Capps, a former co-worker she used to work with at a bar called Hurricane Grill and Wings
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，丹妮拉给兰迪·卡普斯发送了一条 Facebook 消息，兰迪是她以前在一家名为“飓风烧烤与翅膀”的酒吧工作时的同事。

sentences.en: As the bar was in the same area as her errands, Daniela considered stopping by for a drink
sentences.zh: 由于这家酒吧在她办事的同一片区域，丹妮拉考虑顺便去喝一杯。

sentences.en: Randy responded that he was indeed working that night, but he now worked at Hero's Sports Bar and Grill, where she would be welcome to come by.
sentences.zh: 兰迪回复说他当晚确实在上班，不过他现在在英雄体育酒吧餐厅工作，欢迎她随时过来。

sentences.en: Daniella responded,
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉回复说，

sentences.en: But I don't like going to a place I've never been before.
sentences.zh: “但我不喜欢去从没去过的地方。

sentences.en: Hurricanes is just along the way of whatever responsible things I have to get done so I can stop by and drink mid-bill paying.
sentences.zh: 飓风酒吧正好顺路，我办完正事可以顺便去喝一杯，就在付账单的间隙。”

sentences.en: Randy replied
sentences.zh: 兰迪回复道：

sentences.en: LOL, I hear ya
sentences.zh: “哈哈，我懂的。

sentences.en: Well, I'm here Not like you don't know anyone
sentences.zh: 好吧，我就在这，又不是谁都不认识。”

sentences.en: At 5.20pm, Daniela left her apartment dressed casually in black leggings
sentences.zh: 下午 5 点 20 分，丹妮拉离开公寓，身穿休闲黑色打底裤，

sentences.en: A dark coloured shirt with a mellow mushroom pizza chain logo on the pocket And black high-top Converse sneakers
sentences.zh: 一件深色衬衫（口袋上印有“蘑菇慢跑”比萨连锁店的标志），脚穿黑色高帮匡威运动鞋。

sentences.en: Her ever-changing hair was currently dark brown with red tips around the fringe and she wore it up in a ponytail.
sentences.zh: 她那百变的发型目前是深棕色，刘海周围带有红色的发梢，扎成了一个马尾辫。

sentences.en: She also wore a pink baseball cap that had a cartoon donut sewn on the front, the type favoured by cartoon character Homer Simpson.
sentences.zh: 她还戴着一顶粉色棒球帽，前面缝着一个卡通甜甜圈，也就是卡通人物荷马·辛普森最喜欢的那种。

sentences.en: Daniela stopped at a small strip mall on University Drive before continuing to the Shop's Mall at Bel Air at
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉在大学大道的一个小商业街逗留了一会儿，然后继续前往贝尔气氛购物中心，

sentences.en: 5.50pm, a shopping centre offering a mix of department stores, specialty shops, cafes and restaurants.
sentences.zh: 抵达时间是下午 5 点 50 分。这是一个集百货公司、专卖店、咖啡馆和餐厅于一体的购物中心。

sentences.en: P.F.
sentences.zh: P.F.

sentences.en: Chang's sits on the outside of the mall, just to the right of the main entrance.
sentences.zh: Chang's 餐厅位于购物中心外侧，正对主入口的右侧。

sentences.en: At the mall, Daniela bumped into a co-worker and the two had a brief exchange, with Daniela saying how relieved she was to finally have a car.
sentences.zh: 在购物中心里，丹妮拉偶遇了一位同事并简单交流了几句，丹妮拉说她终于买到车了，感到如释重负。

sentences.en: She couldn't stop to chat long because she was on a mission to buy Cora a backpack for school.
sentences.zh: 她不能多聊天，因为她身上还有任务，要给科拉买个上学用的双肩包。

sentences.en: After she was done shopping, Daniela made the 18-minute journey to Hero's Sports Bar and Grill, where her former colleague Randy was on duty behind the bar
sentences.zh: 买完东西后，丹妮拉驱车 18 分钟来到“英雄体育酒吧餐厅”，她的前同事兰迪当时正在吧台值班。

sentences.en: At 35 years old, Randy was 10 years older than Daniela
sentences.zh: 兰迪 35 岁，比丹妮拉大 10 岁。

sentences.en: He had a checkered past, with previous arrests for drug possession, possession of stolen property and driving under the influence
sentences.zh: 他有着一段劣迹斑斑的过去，曾因藏毒、藏匿赃物和酒后驾驶而被捕。

sentences.en: Just after 6.30pm, Daniela settled in at the bar where she could chat to Randy between him serving drinks
sentences.zh: 傍晚 6 点 30 分刚过，丹妮拉在吧台安顿下来，这样可以在兰迪招待客人间隙和他聊天。

sentences.en: Heroes was a large sports bar with multiple televisions screening various sporting events
sentences.zh: “英雄”是一家大型体育酒吧，里面有多台电视机播放着各种体育赛事。

sentences.en: The two chatted, and before long, two more of Randy's friends entered the bar and sat nearby
sentences.zh: 两人闲聊着，不久之后，兰迪的另外两个朋友也走进酒吧，并在附近坐下。

sentences.en: They were Denson White, who was aged in his early 40s, and Mallory Miller-Kenworthy, who was in her mid-30s
sentences.zh: 他们是 40 出头的登森·怀特，以及 30 岁中旬的马洛里·米勒-肯沃西。

sentences.en: Denson, Mallory and Randy all played on the same softball team
sentences.zh: 登森、马洛里和兰迪都在同一个垒球队打球。

sentences.en: There was supposed to be a game that night, but it had been called off due to the rain So Mallory and Denson had decided to go to Heroes to watch the All-Stars game
sentences.zh: 本来当晚有一场比赛，但因为下雨取消了，所以马洛里和登森决定去“英雄”酒吧观看全明星赛。

sentences.en: Denson, Mallory and Daniela sat together watching the game and chatting to Randy while he worked behind the bar.
sentences.zh: 登森、马洛里和丹妮拉坐在一起看比赛，并和在吧台工作的兰迪聊天。

sentences.en: It was Daniela's first time meeting Denson, but she and Mallory had met before as they had friends in the same social circles.
sentences.zh: 这是丹妮拉第一次见到登森，但她和马洛里以前就见过，因为她们的朋友圈有交集。

sentences.en: Mallory had a newborn baby and like Daniela, it was her first night out since giving birth six weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 马洛里有一个新生婴儿，和丹妮拉一样，这也是她自六周前分娩以来的第一个夜晚外出。

sentences.en: Denson had just returned from a work trip away and had driven to Heroes in his rental car.
sentences.zh: 登森刚结束一次出差回来，是开着租来的车去的“英雄”酒吧。

sentences.en: He worked for APM Terminals at the Mobile
sentences.zh: 他在莫比尔港的 APM Terminals 工作，

sentences.en: Ports, a busy dock where 1,200 shipping containers went in and out on an average day.
sentences.zh: 那是一个繁忙的码头，平均每天有 1,200 个集装箱进出。

sentences.en: Denson was a dealmaker who had received many honours for the business he brought into Mobile.
sentences.zh: 登森是个业务能手，曾因给莫比尔带来的业务而获得过多项荣誉。

sentences.en: At 7.14pm, Daniela responded to a text from Julie regarding some local gossip.
sentences.zh: 晚上 7 点 14 分，丹妮拉回复了朱莉关于一些当地八卦的短信。

sentences.en: One minute later, at 7.15, she messaged her friend and colleague, Hannah, to say she hadn't seen her car near P.F.
sentences.zh: 一分钟后的 7 点 15 分，她给朋友兼同事汉娜发信息，说她刚才在购物中心时，

sentences.en: Chang's when she stopped at the mall.
sentences.zh: 没看到汉娜的车停在 P.F. Chang's 附近。

sentences.en: Hannah responded that she was indeed working that evening.
sentences.zh: 汉娜回复说她当晚确实在上班。

sentences.en: At 7.36pm, Daniela messaged Hannah again, saying
sentences.zh: 晚上 7 点 36 分，丹妮拉再次给汉娜发信息，说：

sentences.en: I'm drinking happily at a sports bar To which Hannah replied
sentences.zh: “我在体育酒吧喝得很开心。”对此汉娜回复道：

sentences.en: Hell yes, taking advantage of the freedom
sentences.zh: “太棒了，好好享受这份自由。”

sentences.en: Daniela, Mallory and Denson made plans to move on to Dublin Pub and Eatery just half a mile down the road
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉、马洛里和登森计划转场去顺路半英里外的“都柏林酒吧餐厅”。

sentences.en: It was an Irish-themed bar that had opened two months earlier, with live music and a lot more atmosphere than Heroes
sentences.zh: 那是一家两个月前开业的爱尔兰主题酒吧，有现场音乐，氛围比“英雄”酒吧浓厚得多。

sentences.en: They agreed to meet Randy at a third bar, Ollie's Mediterranean Grill, when he finished work later that night
sentences.zh: 他们约定等兰迪当晚晚些时候下班后，在第三家酒吧——奥利地中海烧烤店汇合。

sentences.en: Ollie's was another former workplace of Daniela's and was closer to her apartment
sentences.zh: 奥利酒吧也是丹妮拉曾经工作过的地方，而且离她的公寓更近。

sentences.en: Randy expected to finish work around 11pm and said he would text them when he was leaving At 8.25pm, Daniela sent a text to Hannah that read
sentences.zh: 兰迪预计晚上 11 点左右下班，并说他离开时会发短信通知他们。晚上 8 点 25 分，丹妮拉给汉娜发了一条短信：

sentences.en: Okay, I'm going to drive now, but should I?
sentences.zh: “好了，我要开车了，但我是不是该开车呢？

sentences.en: I don't know She had consumed a few drinks while at Heroes but didn't appear to be drunk
sentences.zh: 我不知道。”她在“英雄”酒吧时喝了几杯酒，但看起来并没有喝醉。

sentences.en: However, it's possible that she may have taken a couple of her Norco painkillers which could result in serious side effects when mixed with alcohol
sentences.zh: 不过，她也有可能服用了几片诺科止痛药，如果与酒精混合使用，可能会产生严重的副作用。

sentences.en: At 8.57pm, Daniela and Denson became Facebook friends and Denson sent Daniela an invitation to a party at his house that was to be held a couple of weeks later
sentences.zh: 晚上 8 点 57 分，丹妮拉和登森加了 Facebook 好友，登森向丹妮拉发出了邀请，去参加几周后在他家举办的一个派对。

sentences.en: At 9.12pm, Daniela hugged Randy goodbye and she, Denson and Mallory left Heroes for their next destination.
sentences.zh: 晚上 9 点 12 分，丹妮拉拥抱告别兰迪，她、登森和马洛里离开“英雄”酒吧前往下一个目的地。

sentences.en: As soon as Daniela was outside, she sent two Facebook messages to Randy, but he didn't respond to either.
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉刚走到外面，就给兰迪发了两条 Facebook 消息，但兰迪两条都没回。

sentences.en: At 9.16pm, she attempted to call Hannah, who was still working and didn't answer.
sentences.zh: 晚上 9 点 16 分，她试图打电话给还在上班、没有接听电话的汉娜。

sentences.en: At 9.46pm, Daniela sent Hannah a short video via the messaging app Snapchat of her sitting alone in the driver's seat of her car
sentences.zh: 晚上 9 点 46 分，丹妮拉通过聊天软件 Snapchat 给汉娜发送了一个短视频，视频中她独自坐在汽车的驾驶座上。

sentences.en: The clip contained nothing out of the ordinary, although Hannah did notice that Daniela appeared to be a little intoxicated
sentences.zh: 这段视频没有什么特别之处，不过汉娜确实注意到丹妮拉看起来有点醉意。

sentences.en: As is the case with Snapchat messages, the video played once before being automatically deleted
sentences.zh: 正如 Snapchat 消息的特点一样，这段视频播放一次后便会自动删除。

sentences.en: Hannah tried to call Daniela shortly afterwards But there was no answer
sentences.zh: Hannah尝试在不久后给Daniela打电话，但无人接听。

sentences.en: According to the GPS records in Daniela's car She left the Hero's car park at 10.05pm
sentences.zh: 根据Daniela车内的GPS记录，她于晚上10点05分离开英雄酒吧停车场。

sentences.en: Nearly one hour after exiting the bar
sentences.zh: 距离她离开酒吧将近一个小时。

sentences.en: It isn't known whether she stayed in the car park by herself the entire time Or caught a lift to Dublin's earlier with Denson or Mallory before returning for her car later.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚她是一直独自留在停车场，还是早些时候跟Denson或Mallory搭车去了都柏林酒吧，之后才返回开自己的车。

sentences.en: At 10.08pm, Daniela's car pulled into Dublin's where she continued socialising with Denson and Mallory.
sentences.zh: 晚上10点08分，Daniela的车开进了都柏林酒吧，并在那里继续与Denson和Mallory社交。

sentences.en: At some point, Mallory announced that she was going to a pool hall called The Runway Bar to catch up with friends and would meet up with Daniela, Denson and Randy later at Ollie's.
sentences.zh: 期间，Mallory宣布她要去一家名为“跑道酒吧”的台球厅找朋友，并会在稍后去奥利酒吧与Daniela、Denson和Randy汇合。

sentences.en: However, Denson said he had decided to go home.
sentences.zh: 然而，Denson说他决定回家。

sentences.en: instead of continuing on.
sentences.zh: 不再继续同行。

sentences.en: At 10.44pm, Randy sent Daniela a Facebook message to let her know he was about to finish work and would head straight to Ollie's.
sentences.zh: 晚上10点44分，Randy给Daniela发了一条Facebook消息，告知她自己快下班了，将直接前往奥利酒吧。

sentences.en: One minute later, at 10.45pm,
sentences.zh: 一分钟后，即晚上10点45分，

sentences.en: Daniela, Denson and Mallory each left Dublin's in their separate vehicles.
sentences.zh: Daniela、Denson和Mallory各自驾驶自己的车离开了都柏林酒吧。

sentences.en: Randy arrived at Ollie's three minutes later
sentences.zh: 三分钟后，Randy抵达了奥利酒吧。

sentences.en: Unable to find the group He called Denson at 10.57pm But there was no answer So he settled in to wait for the others to arrive
sentences.zh: 由于找不到大家，他在晚上10点57分给Denson打电话，但无人接听，于是他坐下来等待其他人到达。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly
sentences.zh: “案卷”节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期赞助商广告对我们的支持。

sentences.zh: 嘿，你看见我的猫了吗？

sentences.en: No, sorry
sentences.zh: 没有，抱歉。

sentences.en: Well, he's at home on my couch.
sentences.zh: 哦，它正躺在家里的沙发上呢。

sentences.en: Here's a picture of him.
sentences.zh: 这是它的照片。

sentences.en: Handsome, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 很帅气吧？

sentences.en: Keep your cat safe at home.
sentences.zh: 把你的猫安全留在家里。

sentences.en: They'll live 70% longer on average.
sentences.zh: 它们的平均寿命能延长70%。

sentences.en: A message from RSPCA New South Wales with support from the Environmental TruSt.
sentences.zh: 这是新南威尔士州防止虐待动物协会（RSPCA）携手环境信托基金发布的公益信息。

sentences.en: Hey, Jules, I just saw your cat.
sentences.zh: 嘿，朱尔斯，我刚才看到你的猫了。

sentences.en: Well, he should be at home.
sentences.zh: 呃，它应该在家才对。

sentences.en: Where'd you see him?
sentences.zh: 你在哪儿看到它的？

sentences.en: On Instagram.
sentences.zh: 在Instagram上。

sentences.en: Such a funny picture.
sentences.zh: 太搞笑的一张照片了。

sentences.zh: 把你的猫安全留在家里。

sentences.en: They'll live 70% longer on average.
sentences.zh: 它们的平均寿命能延长70%。

sentences.en: A message from RSPCA New South Wales with support from the Environmental TruSt.
sentences.zh: 这是新南威尔士州防止虐待动物协会（RSPCA）携手环境信托基金发布的公益信息。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: The drive from Dublin's to Ollie's was only 2.8 miles and required a left turn out of the car park.
sentences.zh: 从都柏林酒吧到奥利酒吧只有2.8英里，出停车场时需要向左转。

sentences.en: Denson's house was in the opposite direction and required a right turn.
sentences.zh: Denson的家在相反的方向，需要向右转。

sentences.en: According to the GPS data from Daniela's car, upon leaving the car park, she also took a right
sentences.zh: 根据Daniela车内的GPS数据，她在离开停车场时也向右

sentences.en: turn, which was odd given she knew the area incredibly well and was fully aware that Ollie's was in the opposite direction.
sentences.zh: 转了弯。这很奇怪，因为她对这一带非常熟悉，而且完全清楚奥利酒吧在相反的方向。

sentences.en: Mallory saw this manoeuvre and noted it as strange but continued on to the runway bar to meet her friends without giving it much thought.
sentences.zh: Mallory看到了这个举动，觉得有点蹊跷，但没有多想，便继续前往跑道酒吧去见她的朋友们。

sentences.en: Denson later said he wasn't aware that Daniela was following him until 15 minutes later when they were passing
sentences.zh: Denson后来表示，他直到15分钟后才意识到Daniela一直在跟着他。当时他们正经过

sentences.en: through a quiet industrial area and she flashed her lights to indicate she wanted him to pull over.
sentences.zh: 一个安静的工业区，Daniela闪烁车灯示意他靠边停车。

sentences.en: Although there were open gas stations at a Waffle House nearby, at 11.05pm, the two cars pulled into a dark, closed Shell gas station at 3550 Government Boulevard in Mobile.
sentences.zh: 尽管附近有一家Waffle House旁边就有营业的加油站，但在晚上11点05分，这两辆车却开进莫比尔市政府大道3550号一家黑暗且已关门的壳牌加油站。

sentences.en: Once they stopped,
sentences.zh: 车停下后，

sentences.en: Daniela told Denson that she had lost her mobile phone
sentences.zh: Daniela告诉Denson她把手机弄丢了。

sentences.en: At 11.07pm
sentences.zh: 晚上11点07分，

sentences.en: The GPS in her car made its final location call
sentences.zh: 她车内的GPS发出了最后一次位置信号。

sentences.en: The GPS installed by Paul Motors Was plugged securely into an outlet
sentences.zh: 由Paul Motors安装的GPS

sentences.en: Underneath the steering wheel And was highly unlikely to come out accidentally
sentences.zh: 稳固地插在方向盘下方的插座里，

sentences.en: The fact that it made its final signal at 11.07pm indicated it had either been unplugged or that a fuse had blown, either coincidentally or because it had been tampered with.
sentences.zh: 几乎不可能意外脱落。

sentences.en: After this, it stopped sending locations back to the base.
sentences.zh: 它在晚上11点07分发出最后一个信号这一事实表明，它要么是被拔掉了，要么是保险丝烧断了——不管是巧合还是被人动了手脚。

sentences.en: Denson then called Daniela's phone via Facebook Messenger.
sentences.zh: 在此之后，它便停止向基站发送位置信息。

sentences.en: It is unclear why he did this instead of dialing her number, but the most likely reason is that Daniela had a habit of losing and changing
sentences.zh: 随后，Denson通过Facebook Messenger给Daniela的手机打了电话。

sentences.en: phones and hadn't yet memorised her own number.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚他为什么这么做而不是直接拨打她的号码，但最有可能的原因是Daniela有丢手机和换手机的习惯，当时还没记住自己的号码。

sentences.en: It would have been even more difficult for her to remember if she was under the influence.
sentences.zh: 如果她当时喝了酒，要记住号码就更难了。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Mallory had arrived at Ollie's after a short stop at the runway bar and was sitting with Randy waiting for Daniela to arrive.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，Mallory在跑道酒吧短暂停留后也到达了奥利酒吧，并和Randy坐在一起等待Daniela的到来。

sentences.en: At 11.17pm, Denson called Randy, explaining that Daniela had lost her phone and he was going back to Dublin's to look for it.
sentences.zh: 晚上11点17分，Denson给Randy打电话，解释说Daniela把手机弄丢了，他要回都柏林酒吧去找找。

sentences.en: At 11.24pm, both Daniela and Denson's car drove out of the Shell gas station and turned towards Dublin's.
sentences.zh: 晚上11点24分，Daniela和Denson的车一起驶离壳牌加油站，朝都柏林酒吧方向开去。

sentences.en: Daniela followed Denson for a while before making a turn towards a more populated part of town.
sentences.zh: Daniela跟着Denson开了一会儿，然后转弯朝镇上人口更密集的地区开去。

sentences.en: Just over 10 minutes later, at 11.37pm, Denson sent
sentences.zh: 仅仅10分钟多一点后，即晚上11点37分，Denson从都柏林酒吧

sentences.en: Mallory a text message from Dublin's that contained a selfie of him standing at the bar.
sentences.zh: 给Mallory发了一条短信，里面附了一张他在酒吧吧台前的自拍。

sentences.en: Underneath the photo, he wrote,
sentences.zh: 在照片下方，他写道：

sentences.en: Getting phone, just got back here, but somehow lost to Daniela.
sentences.zh: 在找手机，刚回到这儿，但不知怎么把Daniela跟丢了。

sentences.en: A server at Dublin's had found Daniela's phone on the back of a car and placed it behind the bar for safekeeping.
sentences.zh: 都柏林酒吧的一名服务员在车座背面找到了Daniela的手机，并把它放在吧台后面妥善保管。

sentences.en: Denson retrieved it from the bartender and at 11.52pm he called Daniela via
sentences.zh: Denson从酒保那里取回了手机，并在晚上11点52分通过

sentences.en: Facebook Messenger.
sentences.zh: Facebook Messenger给Daniela打了电话。

sentences.en: It's unclear why he tried to do so considering he had her phone and she presumably had no way of answering the call.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚他为什么要这么做，考虑到他手里拿着她的手机，而她按理说也没法接听电话。

sentences.en: When there was no answer, Denson wrote Daniela a Facebook message that read,
sentences.zh: 在无人接听后，Denson给Daniela发了一条Facebook消息，上面写着：

sentences.en: Call me.
sentences.zh: 给我回电话。

sentences.en: Dublin had your phone.
sentences.zh: 都柏林酒吧有你的手机。

sentences.en: At approximately midnight, Denson drove to Ollie's, where Randy and Mallory told him that Daniela hadn't shown up.
sentences.zh: 大约午夜时分，Denson开车来到奥利酒吧，Randy和Mallory在那里告诉他Daniela一直没有出现。

sentences.en: At 12.04 and then again at 12.33am,
sentences.zh: 在12点04分以及随后的12点33分，

sentences.en: Denson attempted video calling Daniela via Facebook Messenger.
sentences.zh: Denson试图通过Facebook Messenger给Daniela进行视频通话。

sentences.en: When there was no response, he asked Randy what to do with the phone.
sentences.zh: 在无人回应后，他问Randy该怎么处理这部手机。

sentences.en: Randy suggested that Denson take it to PF Chang's the next day where Daniela could be reunited with it on her next shift.
sentences.zh: Randy建议Denson第二天把手机带到PF Chang's餐厅，这样Daniela在下次上班时就能拿回手机了。

sentences.en: Denson agreed and left
sentences.zh: Denson同意了，并离开了

sentences.en: Dublin's, taking Daniela's phone with him.
sentences.zh: 都柏林酒吧，带走了Daniela的手机。

sentences.en: At 7.30 the next morning of Wednesday July 18,
sentences.zh: 第二天早上（7月18日星期三）7点30分，

sentences.en: Hannah sent Daniela a text message asking if she was okay.
sentences.zh: Hannah给Daniela发了一条短信，问她是否还好。

sentences.en: Assuming her friend had had a big night out, Hannah didn't expect to receive a response right away and after sending the text, she went about her day.
sentences.zh: Hannah以为她的朋友前一晚玩得很疯，所以没指望马上收到回复。发完短信后，她便开始忙自己的日常事务了。

sentences.en: At the same time, Julie Thomas received a phone call from Denson to say he had found Daniela's phone.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，Julie Thomas接到Denson打来的电话，说他找到了Daniela的手机。

sentences.en: He gave no indication that he knew Daniela personally or had been with her the previous night.
sentences.zh: 他没有透露任何迹象表明自己认识Daniela，或者前一晚曾和她在一起。

sentences.en: Julie was under the impression that he was a complete stranger.
sentences.zh: Julie误以为他是个完全的陌生人。

sentences.en: She told Denson to drop the phone off at Daniela's workplace, but he didn't follow this suggestion.
sentences.zh: 她告诉Denson把手机送到Daniela的工作单位，但他没有听从这个建议。

sentences.en: Instead, he called Julie twice more throughout the course of the day.
sentences.zh: 相反，他在这一天里又给Julie打了两个电话。

sentences.en: She eventually told him to just hang on to the phone and that Daniela would be in touch once she reappeared.
sentences.zh: 她最终告诉他先拿着手机就行，等Daniela露面后会跟他联系的。

sentences.en: On Thursday July 19,
sentences.zh: 7月19日星期四，

sentences.en: Julie's husband Patrick, son PJ, and granddaughter Cora returned home from their week-long visit to see Patrick's family.
sentences.zh: Julie的丈夫Patrick、儿子PJ以及孙女Cora结束了为期一周探望Patrick家人的旅行回到了家中。

sentences.en: Over lunch, Cora told Julie all about the trip away.
sentences.zh: 吃午饭时，Cora向Julie滔滔不绝地讲起了这次外出旅行的见闻。

sentences.en: As the afternoon wore on,
sentences.zh: 随着下午过去，

sentences.en: Julie anticipated Daniela would walk through the door at any moment.
sentences.zh: Julie期待着Daniela随时会推门而入。

sentences.en: Although Daniela was often late for her visits, Julie expected that she would have turned up in time to welcome Cora home
sentences.zh: 尽管Daniela探访时经常迟到，但Julie预计她理应赶在Cora外出一周归来时出现并表示欢迎，

sentences.en: after a week away and couldn't help but be annoyed by her tardiness.
sentences.zh: 对于她的磨蹭，Julie不禁感到有些恼火。

sentences.en: When Thursday night rolled around and there was still no word from Daniela, Julie started to worry.
sentences.zh: 当周四夜晚降临，依然没有任何关于Daniela的消息时，Julie开始担心起来。

sentences.en: Cora had been tucked safely in bed without a goodnight kiss from her mother, which was highly unusual.
sentences.zh: Cora已经被安顿上床睡觉了，却没有得到妈妈的晚安吻，这极其反常。

sentences.en: Despite any other issues going on in Daniela's life, she was loving and reliable when it came to her daughter.
sentences.zh: 不管Daniela的生活中还有什么其他问题，在对待女儿这件事上，她一直是充满爱心且靠谱的。

sentences.en: Julie tried privately messaging Daniela on Facebook, which was
sentences.zh: Julie尝试在Facebook上私信Daniela，这是

sentences.en: Daniela's preferred method of contact.
sentences.zh: Daniela首选的联系方式。

sentences.en: She kept checking to see whether there was a response, but the message hadn't been viewed and Facebook indicated it had been two days since Daniela was last active.
sentences.zh: 她一直查看是否有回复，但消息并未被已读，Facebook显示Daniela上次活跃已是两天前。

sentences.en: Unsure what else to do, Julie posted a message for Daniela on her public Facebook feed asking her to get in touch.
sentences.zh: Julie不知还能做些什么，便在Daniela的公共动态上发了一条消息，请她与家里联系。

sentences.en: When Daniela's friend Hannah arrived at work that evening, one of her colleagues asked if she had spoken to Daniela, as no one had been able to get a hold of her.
sentences.zh: 当晚Daniela的朋友Hannah到达单位上班时，一位同事问她是否和Daniela联系过，因为谁也联系不上她。

sentences.en: Hannah realised she had never received a response to the text message she'd sent to Daniela the previous morning.
sentences.zh: Hannah这才意识到，她发给Daniela的前一天早上的短信至今没有收到任何回复。

sentences.en: She texted her again via phone and Facebook Messenger, but received no response.
sentences.zh: 她再次通过手机短信和Facebook Messenger给她发信息，但依然没有回应。

sentences.en: Sensing something was wrong, Hannah messaged mutual friends to see if anyone had heard from Daniela.
sentences.zh: Hannah隐约觉得有些不对劲，便给共同的朋友发信息，看看有没有人听到过Daniela的消息。

sentences.en: One person responded that on Tuesday night, Daniela had mentioned she was going to Heroes Sports Bar and Grill.
sentences.zh: 其中一人回复说，周二晚上，Daniela曾提过她要去英雄运动酒吧餐厅（Heroes Sports Bar and Grill）。

sentences.en: Hannah called Heroes and asked the manager to check the car park for a dark blue Chevy Cruze, but there was no car there matching that description.
sentences.zh: Hannah给Heroes打去电话，请经理帮忙查看停车场里有没有一辆深蓝色雪佛兰科鲁兹，但并没有发现符合该特征的车。

sentences.en: The manager offered to check who had been working on Tuesday night to see if anyone recalled seeing Daniela.
sentences.zh: 经理主动提出查一下周二晚上是谁在上班，看看有没有人记起见过Daniela。

sentences.en: He called Hannah back shortly after to say that the bartender on duty,
sentences.zh: 他不久后回电Hannah，说当班的酒保

sentences.en: Randy Capps, confirmed that Daniela had been at Heroes and had been hanging out with Denson White and Mallory Miller-Kenworthy.
sentences.zh: Randy Capps证实Daniela确实去过Heroes，并且和Denson White以及Mallory Miller-Kenworthy在一起。

sentences.en: Hannah didn't know Denson but was able to track him down through Facebook.
sentences.zh: Hannah不认识Denson，但通过Facebook找到了他。

sentences.en: At 9.17pm on Thursday July 19, she sent him a Facebook message that said,
sentences.zh: 7月19日星期四晚上9点17分，她给他发了一条Facebook消息，内容是：

sentences.en: Later that night, Denson called Hannah to say that he hadn't seen Daniela since Tuesday night, but he had her phone and had been trying to return it to her.
sentences.zh: 那天夜里，Denson给Hannah打来电话，称自己自周二晚上起就没见过Daniela，但他拿着她的手机，并且一直在设法把它还给她。

sentences.en: Afterwards, Hannah drove to Daniela's apartment but found no sign of her there
sentences.zh: 此后，Hannah开车去了Daniela的公寓，但在那里没有发现她的任何踪迹。

sentences.en: She sent another message to Daniela on Facebook that said
sentences.zh: 她在Facebook上又给Daniela发了一条消息，写道：

sentences.en: Hey, what's up?
sentences.zh: 嘿，怎么啦？

sentences.en: Everybody's worried
sentences.zh: 大家都挺担心的。

sentences.en: The next morning of Friday July 20, Hannah drove by Daniela's apartment on her way to cosmetology school But it was clear that she hadn't been home
sentences.zh: 第二天（7月20日星期五）早上，Hannah在去美容学校的路上开车路过了Daniela的公寓，但很明显她并没有回过家。

sentences.en: Daniela was scheduled to work a 10am shift at P.F.
sentences.zh: Daniela本计划在P.F.

sentences.en: Chang's, so Hannah dropped by the restaurant to see if she had shown up.
sentences.zh: Chang's餐厅进行上午10点的班次，于是Hannah顺路去了这家餐厅，看看她有没有露面。

sentences.en: Realising she hadn't, Hannah called Julie and then messaged Denson to let them know that there was still no sign of Daniela.
sentences.zh: 意识到她没有来后，Hannah给Julie打了电话，随后又给Denson发了信息，告知他们依然没有Daniela的踪迹。

sentences.en: Julie, Hannah and Denson exchanged a flurry of calls and text messages and decided it was time to report Daniela missing.
sentences.zh: Julie、Hannah和Denson通过一连串的电话和短信进行沟通，并决定是时候报案说Daniela失踪了。

sentences.en: Although it wasn't unusual for the fun-loving 25-year-old to be out of contact for a day or two,
sentences.zh: 尽管这个爱好玩乐的25岁姑娘失联一两天并不罕见，

sentences.en: the fact she had missed work and hadn't shown up to greet her daughter were both major red flags
sentences.zh: 但她缺勤且没有出现去迎接女儿，这两点都是亮起的重大红灯。

sentences.en: Julie and Denson arranged to meet at the police station on Airport Boulevard and Doors,
sentences.zh: Julie和Denson商定在机场大道（Airport Boulevard）和Doors的警察局会合，

sentences.en: where Julie could file a missing persons report and Denson could hand over the phone and make a statement
sentences.zh: 届时Julie可以提交失踪人口报告，而Denson则可以交出手机并做一份笔录。

sentences.en: Once there, they were instructed to go to the office on Government Street where the missing persons liaison unit was located
sentences.zh: 到了那里后，他们被指示前往位于政府街（Government Street）的失踪人口联络处办公室。

sentences.en: On the way, Julie called Hannah to ask if she knew the six-digit number to unlock Daniela's phone
sentences.zh: 在路上，Julie给Hannah打电话，问她是否知道解锁Daniela手机的六位数密码。

sentences.en: Hannah advised that it was Daniela's employee number and she gave this number to Julie
sentences.zh: Hannah告知那是Daniela的员工编号，并将这个数字告诉了Julie。

sentences.en: Once Julie had unlocked the phone, she read through all of the text messages Daniela had sent and received during the past week And also listened to her voicemail
sentences.zh: Julie解锁手机后，翻阅了Daniela在过去一周内发送和接收的所有短信，还听了她的语音信箱。

sentences.en: By the time Julie arrived at the missing persons liaison unit, Denson had provided his statement to the police
sentences.zh: 当Julie抵达失踪人口联络处时，Denson已经向警方做完了笔录。

sentences.en: Hannah also arrived to make a statement about how out of character it was for Daniela to be out of contact for so long and not to show for her shift when she needed money the most
sentences.zh: Hannah也赶到了，准备作证说明Daniela失联这么久、且在最需要钱的时候却不来上班是多么反常的行为。

sentences.en: Julie provided as much information as she could and surrendered Daniela's phone to the police
sentences.zh: Julie提供了她所能提供的尽可能多的信息，并将Daniela的手机交给了警方。

sentences.en: An officer later accompanied her to Daniela's apartment where a crime scene officer met them to conduct an assessment.
sentences.zh: 随后，一名警官陪同她来到Daniela的公寓，一名犯罪现场调查警官在那里与他们汇合并进行勘察。

sentences.en: But nothing seemed to be missing or out of the ordinary.
sentences.zh: 但似乎没有什么东西丢失或有异常情况。

sentences.en: When Julie returned home, she logged on to her computer, where Daniela had saved the login details for her various social media accounts.
sentences.zh: Julie回到家后，登录了自己的电脑。Daniela在那里保存了她各个社交媒体账户的登录信息。

sentences.en: She signed into Daniela's Facebook account, where she noticed several missed calls from Denson White.
sentences.zh: 她登录了Daniela的Facebook账户，发现上面有几个Denson White打来的未接来电。

sentences.en: At 11.11pm on the night Daniela was last seen, just minutes after the GPS on her car pinged for the last time.
sentences.zh: 在Daniela最后一次露面当晚的晚上11点11分，也就是她车上的GPS最后一次发出信号的几分钟后，

sentences.en: Denson's Facebook account had left a voice message to Daniela's account.
sentences.zh: Denson的Facebook账户给Daniela的账户留了一条语音消息。

sentences.en: It appeared to have been left by accident and featured rustling noises accompanied by a female voice, believed to be Daniela's.
sentences.zh: 这条消息似乎是意外留下的，里面夹杂着沙沙的摩擦声，还伴随着一个女性的声音，据信是Daniela的声音。

sentences.en: Warning, some listeners may find the following audio clip distressing.
sentences.zh: 警告：部分听众可能会觉得接下来的音频片段引起不适。

sentences.en: A minute later, another seemingly accidental voice message was left from Denson's Facebook
sentences.zh: 一分钟后，Denson的Facebook账户给Daniela留下了另一条看似意外的语音消息，

sentences.en: account to Daniela's, featuring much of the same rustling noises, as well as a muffled male voice speaking to the female and instructing her not to touch something.
sentences.zh: 其中包含许多同样的沙沙声，还有一个低沉的男性声音在对女性说话，指示她不要碰某样东西。

sentences.en: Julie called the police to tell them about the voice messages, and they advised her not to log back into Daniela's Facebook account in case it tainted evidence.
sentences.zh: Julie打电话给警方告知了这些语音消息的事，警方建议她不要重新登录Daniela的Facebook账户，以免破坏证据。

sentences.en: When Julie inquired about CCTV footage that may have been captured at the various locations Daniela had visited, the police told her no such footage had been found.
sentences.zh: 当Julie打听Daniela去过的各个地点是否拍下过监控录像时，警方告诉她并未找到此类录像。

sentences.en: Julie was therefore shocked when a news outlet reporting on Daniela's disappearance featured CCTV footage from the Shell gas station
sentences.zh: 因此，当一家报道Daniela失踪事件的新闻媒体播放了来自壳牌加油站的监控画面时，Julie感到十分震惊。

sentences.en: where the last confirmed sighting of her had taken place.
sentences.zh: 那里正是最后一次确认看到她的地方。

sentences.en: The footage was dark and grainy with poor visibility, but it showed a car pull in at the shell at 11.05pm.
sentences.zh: 画面昏暗而充满噪点，能见度很差，但显示一辆车在晚上11点05分驶入了壳牌加油站。

sentences.en: Seconds later, another car pulled in beside the firSt. A couple of minutes later, the second car left and then immediately after, another one pulled in.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟后，另一辆车开进来停在第一辆车旁边。几分钟后，第二辆车离开，紧接着又有一辆车开进来。

sentences.en: Given the poor quality, it was impossible to tell whether the second car had left and returned or if a different third vehicle drove in after the second car departed.
sentences.zh: 鉴于画质太差，根本无法分辨第二辆车是离开后又返回了，还是在第二辆车离开后有另一辆不同的第三辆车开进来了。

sentences.en: No people were visible in the footage due to its poor quality.
sentences.zh: 由于画质糟糕，画面中看不到任何人影。

sentences.en: Julie called the police demanding to know why the footage was being aired on television when she was told that no footage existed.
sentences.zh: Julie打电话质问警方，为什么在告诉她根本没有监控录像的情况下，电视上却在播这段画面。

sentences.en: Rather than responding, law enforcement officials contacted the news station and demanded the footage be removed.
sentences.zh: 执法官员没有回答，而是联系了新闻台，要求将该视频删除。

sentences.en: The news outlet complied, but no further explanation was given for the police action.
sentences.zh: 这家新闻机构照办了，但警方并未对该行动作出进一步解释。

sentences.en: On Tuesday July 24, less than one week after Daniela was last seen, Julie and her husband
sentences.zh: 7月24日星期二，即丹妮拉失踪不到一周之际，朱莉和她的丈夫

sentences.en: Patrick attended court to finalise custody arrangements for Cora.
sentences.zh: 帕特里克出席了法院的听证会，以敲定科拉的抚养权安排。

sentences.en: This process had already been going on for several months prior to Daniela's disappearance, with Daniela's full cooperation,
sentences.zh: 在丹妮拉失踪之前，这一程序已经在丹妮拉的全力配合下进行了数月之久，

sentences.en: and a majority of the paperwork had already been signed and filed.
sentences.zh: 绝大部分文书工作都已签署并归档。

sentences.en: The plan had been that Daniela would give Julie and Patrick full custody of Cora until she could get her life in order.
sentences.zh: 原本的计划是，在丹妮拉的生活步入正轨之前，由朱莉和帕特里克完全抚养科拉。

sentences.en: It was clear from Daniela's journal entries about organising Cora's bedroom and having her sleep over 80% of the time that she hoped to regain custody sooner rather than later
sentences.zh: 从丹妮拉日记中关于整理科拉卧室以及让科拉每周有80%的时间留宿的记录来看，她显然希望能尽快重新获得抚养权。

sentences.en: Daniela had always planned to attend the court hearing but as she didn't show up, Julie and Patrick were awarded custody of Cora
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉原本计划出席听证会，但由于她没有现身，法院将科拉的抚养权判给了朱莉和帕特里克。

sentences.en: The following day, Tyler was released from jail and returned to the apartment he shared with Daniela.
sentences.zh: 第二天，泰勒被从监狱释放，并回到了他和丹妮拉合租的公寓。

sentences.en: He immediately took the few items of value that Daniela owned, including her video gaming system and television, and pawned them.
sentences.zh: 他立刻拿走了丹妮拉仅有的几件贵重物品，包括她的游戏机和电视机，并将它们当当掉了。

sentences.en: When Julie found out, she bought the items back.
sentences.zh: 朱莉发现后，把这些东西买回来了。

sentences.en: That same day, the Mobile Police confirmed that the case had been handed over to the Homicide Squad.
sentences.zh: 就在同一天，莫比尔警方证实，该案已移交给凶杀组。

sentences.en: They also released a statement clarifying that while homicide detectives were involved, there wasn't any evidence to suggest that a homicide had occurred.
sentences.zh: 他们还发表了一份声明澄清说，尽管凶杀案调查人员已经介入，但没有任何证据表明发生了凶杀案。

sentences.en: As the GPS device was no longer functioning on Daniela's car,
sentences.zh: 由于丹妮拉汽车上的GPS设备已经无法工作，

sentences.en: Pearl Motors hadn't been able to track its location and there had been no reported sightings of the Chevy Cruze anywhere.
sentences.zh: 珀尔汽车公司无法追踪其位置，而且也没有任何地方目击到这辆雪佛兰科鲁兹的报告。

sentences.en: Investigators were monitoring Daniela's bank account activity and were alerted that her Visa debit card had been used at a gas station.
sentences.zh: 调查人员一直在监控丹妮拉的银行账户活动，并收到警报称她的Visa借记卡曾在一家加油站被使用过。

sentences.en: However, this was linked back to Tyler, who had found the debit card when he had gone through the apartment.
sentences.zh: 然而，这追查到了泰勒身上，他在搜查公寓时发现了这张借记卡。

sentences.en: Hannah had been a frequent visitor to Daniela's apartment, and on Friday July 27, Tyler gave her a key and asked if she noticed anything unusual or out of place.
sentences.zh: 汉娜曾是丹妮拉公寓的常客，7月27日星期 Friday，泰勒给了她一把钥匙，并问她有没有发现什么不寻常或不对劲的地方。

sentences.en: Hannah noted that all of Daniela's possessions were still there, including her make-up, clothes and her phone charger
sentences.zh: 汉娜注意到丹妮拉的所有财物都还在，包括她的化妆品、衣服以及手机充电器。

sentences.en: It was not the scene of someone who had chosen to run away
sentences.zh: 这绝不是一个选择离家出走的人的现场。

sentences.en: The police also searched the apartment
sentences.zh: 警方还搜查了这间公寓。

sentences.en: Daniela kept a whiteboard with a record of her goals and the amount of money she had saved so that she could keep track of her progress
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉保留着一块白板，上面记录着她的目标和已攒下的金额，以便随时了解自己的进度。

sentences.en: Based on the figures on the board, Daniela had around $1,200 cash left in savings, but if that money was in the apartment, there is no official record of it being found.
sentences.zh: 根据白板上的数字，丹妮拉的储蓄中大约还剩1200美元现金，但如果这笔钱在公寓里，官方并没有找到它的记录。

sentences.en: Tyler was unable to maintain the apartment's rental payments and was soon evicted.
sentences.zh: 泰勒无力支付公寓的租金，不久就被驱逐了。

sentences.en: The building manager wouldn't allow
sentences.zh: 大楼经理不允许

sentences.en: Julie in to collect Daniela's possessions, instead dumping them unceremoniously on the pavement outside and letting Julie know she could come and collect them.
sentences.zh: 朱莉进去收拾丹妮拉的物品，而是毫不客气地把它们扔在外面的人行道上，并通知朱莉可以去把它拿走。

sentences.en: Julie went directly over to pick up everything Daniela owned.
sentences.zh: 朱莉直接赶过去拿回了丹妮拉拥有的所有东西。

sentences.en: Then she and Tyler examined all of the iteMs. But they found no clues as to where Daniela might be.
sentences.zh: 然后，她和泰勒检查了所有的物品，但没有找到任何关于丹妮拉可能身在何处的线索。

sentences.en: On Friday September 14, almost two months since Daniela's disappearance, Mobile Police responded to a complaint of unlawful imprisonment and sexual
sentences.zh: 9月14日星期五，距离丹妮拉失踪将近两个月，莫比尔警方接到了一起关于非法拘禁和性侵的报案，

sentences.en: abuse at a home in the town of Theodore, 14 miles south of Mobile.
sentences.zh: 地点位于莫比尔以南14英里的西奥多镇的一处住宅。

sentences.en: Three people were detained and a man named Jason Corey Dykes was arrested on charges of domestic violence, strangulation, assault and unlawful imprisonment.
sentences.zh: 三人被拘留，一名叫杰森·科里·戴克斯的男子因涉嫌家庭暴力、窒息、袭击和非法拘禁而被捕。

sentences.en: Jason, who was Julie Dykes Thomas's nephew, was accused of locking a former girlfriend in a room where he beat and raped her.
sentences.zh: 杰森是朱莉·戴克斯·托马斯的侄子，他被指控将前女友锁在一个房间里进行殴打和强奸。

sentences.en: According to multiple sources, the alleged victim claimed that Jason had said something threatening about Daniela Vianne.
sentences.zh: 据多方消息来源称，据称受害者声称杰森曾说过关于丹妮拉·维安妮的威胁性言论。

sentences.en: However, a raid of the property turned up nothing of interest in the Vianne investigation and police determined that Jason's alleged crimes were unrelated to
sentences.zh: 然而，对该房产的突击搜查在维安妮调查中没有发现任何有价值的线索，警方判定杰森涉嫌的罪行与

sentences.en: Daniela's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉的失踪无关。

sentences.en: The allegations were later proven to be false and Jason was cleared of all charges and ruled out as a person of interest in Daniela's investigation.
sentences.zh: 这些指控后来被证明是虚假的，杰森被洗清了所有罪名，并被排除在丹妮拉案的关注人员之外。

sentences.en: Daniela's loved ones were frustrated by the lack of progress in the case.
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉的亲人们对案件进展缓慢感到沮丧。

sentences.en: Julie set up a GoFundMe campaign to raise money, which she used to print out flyers that were handed out and put into letterboxes in the area.
sentences.zh: 朱莉发起了一项GoFundMe筹款活动来筹集资金，并用这些钱印制了传单，在当地分发并塞进各家各户的信箱里。

sentences.en: She also had billboards mounted that featured Daniela's photo and details about her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 她还让人竖起了广告牌，上面印着丹妮拉的照片和失踪详情。

sentences.en: Just before Christmas, a frustrated Hannah left a one-star review on the Mobile Police Department's Facebook page, writing,
sentences.zh: 就在圣诞节前夕，沮丧的汉娜在莫比尔警察局的Facebook主页上留下了一条一星差评，写道：

sentences.en: Daniela Vian has been missing for five months.
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉·维安已经失踪五个月了。

sentences.en: Five months her baby girl hasn't seen her mum.
sentences.zh: 五个月来，她的宝贝女儿没有见过妈妈。

sentences.en: Five months Daniela hasn't gotten to hold her daughter.
sentences.zh: 五个月来，丹妮拉没能抱抱她的女儿。

sentences.en: Five months her family has had to sit around and wonder when we will all get answers.
sentences.zh: 五个月来，她的家人不得不坐在一起纳闷，我们什么时候才能得到答案。

sentences.en: The Mobile Police Department knows who she was with last, but they say they have run out of leads.
sentences.zh: 莫比尔警察局知道她最后和谁在一起，但他们说线索已经断了。

sentences.en: It's crazy that Mobile Police will post about robberies, stolen property and post surveillance videos asking for help, but not for Daniela.
sentences.zh: 真荒唐，莫比尔警察局会发布关于抢劫、失窃财产的动态，还会发布监控视频寻求帮助，却偏偏不为丹妮拉发。

sentences.en: They post about awards police officers are receiving, but can't post one missing picture of Daniela.
sentences.zh: 他们发布警察获奖的消息，却发不出一张丹妮拉的寻人启事。

sentences.en: They should hand out awards to police officers that find missing people, not stolen property.
sentences.zh: 他们应该把奖项颁发给找到失踪人口的警察，而不是找回失窃财产的警察。

sentences.en: Daniela was stolen.
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉被偷走了。

sentences.en: A person was stolen.
sentences.zh: 一个人被偷走了。

sentences.en: Not some groceries.
sentences.zh: 不是什么杂货。

sentences.en: A person.
sentences.zh: 是一个人。

sentences.en: I have lost all faith in the Mobile Police Department.
sentences.zh: 我对莫比尔警察局彻底失去了信心。

sentences.en: I have hope that some way or another
sentences.zh: 我仍然抱有一丝希望，无论用什么方法

sentences.en: Daniela and all the missing girls from Mobile will be found, but it won't be from the help of the Mobile Police Department.
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉和莫比尔所有失踪的女孩都会被找到，但这绝对不是因为莫比尔警察局的帮助。

sentences.en: They sweep the missing under the rug.
sentences.zh: 他们把失踪人口藏着掖着不予理睬。

sentences.en: Daniela's friends and family maintained pressure on the police to ensure they continued the search.
sentences.zh: 丹妮拉的朋友和家人持续向警方施压，确保他们继续搜寻。

sentences.en: Several vigils had been held since Daniela's disappearance and on March 8 2019, 20 of Daniela's loved ones gathered in
sentences.zh: 自丹妮拉失踪以来，人们已经举行了多次守夜活动。2019年3月8日，20位丹妮拉的亲友聚集在

sentences.en: Medal of Honor Park to commemorate what would have been her 26th birthday.
sentences.zh: 荣誉勋章公园，纪念她本该度过的26岁生日。

sentences.en: Julie purposefully kept Cora away as she didn't want the young girl to associate birthdays with sadness.
sentences.zh: 朱莉刻意没有让科拉出席，因为她不想让这个小女孩把生日和悲伤联系在一起。

sentences.en: Although all the local news outlets were informed, only one member of the media attended.
sentences.zh: 尽管当地所有新闻媒体都得到了通知，但只有一名记者到场。

sentences.en: A prayer was said and then candles were lit on cupcakes as Daniela's friends and family sang happy birthday.
sentences.zh: 在丹妮拉的朋友和家人的生日歌声中，大家进行了祈祷，随后在纸杯蛋糕上点燃了蜡烛。

sentences.en: Months continued to go by without any reported sightings of Daniela or her car and no further clues emerged.
sentences.zh: 几个月过去了，依然没有任何关于丹妮拉或她汽车的目击报告，也没有出现进一步的线索。

sentences.en: Tyler realised how important it was that Cora received as much support as possible and stepped up in his role as parent.
sentences.zh: 泰勒意识到科拉获得尽可能多的支持是多么重要，于是他挺身而出，承担起父亲的责任。

sentences.en: He stopped using drugs and focused on getting a job so he could provide for his daughter, with his love for Cora motivating him to make better decisions.
sentences.zh: 他戒了毒，专心找工作来抚养女儿，对科拉的爱促使他做出更好的决定。

sentences.en: Many theories were put forth by those who knew Daniela and by internet sleuths who became obsessed with the unresolved case.
sentences.zh: 认识丹妮拉的人以及痴迷于这起未解悬案的网络侦探们提出了各种各样的理论。

sentences.en: The theories ranged from Daniela running away to start a new life, to accidentally driving her car into a body of water, to ending her own life.
sentences.zh: 这些理论从丹妮拉离家出走开始新生活，到不小心把车开进水体，再到结束自己的生命，不一而足。

sentences.en: The more sinister theories suggest that she was the victim of a botched carjacking,
sentences.zh: 更阴暗的推测则认为她是一起未遂劫车案的受害者，

sentences.en: that she went to score drugs and was attacked in the process, or was deliberately targeted to settle a debt.
sentences.zh: 她去买毒品并在过程中遭到袭击，或者是被人蓄意针对以清算债务。

sentences.en: One of the more extreme theories was that she fell victim to the sex trafficking trade.
sentences.zh: 其中比较极端的推测之一是她沦为了性贩卖贸易的受害者。

sentences.en: No evidence emerged to support any of these.
sentences.zh: 没有任何证据支持这些说法。

sentences.en: One of the most astonishing details of the case was that Daniela's car hadn't been spotted.
sentences.zh: 该案最令人惊讶的细节之一是，丹妮拉的汽车一直没有被发现。

sentences.en: As it had only been purchased on the day of her disappearance, it didn't yet have permanent license plates and still bore the dealer tags.
sentences.zh: 由于它是在她失踪当天才购买的，因此还没有正式车牌，依然挂着经销商的临时牌照。

sentences.en: While this would have made it easier to spot, it also may have made the car an attractive target for thieves who could give it a new identity in a chop shop
sentences.zh: 虽然这本应更容易被发现，但这也可能使这辆车成为小偷的诱人目标，他们可以在黑市拆车厂里给它一个新身份。

sentences.en: The individuals who were last seen with Daniella, Denson White, Mallory Miller-Kenworthy and Randy Capps all cooperated with the police,
sentences.zh: 最后见到丹妮拉的人——登森·怀特、马洛里·米勒-肯沃西和兰迪·卡普斯——都全力配合警方，

sentences.en: but elected not to provide any statements to the media
sentences.zh: 但选择不向媒体发表任何声明。

sentences.en: One day, Julie and the now five-year-old Cora were driving in the car when Cora suddenly asked,
sentences.zh: 有一天，朱莉和现在五岁的科拉正坐在车里，科拉突然问：

sentences.en: Has Mummy passed on?
sentences.zh: 妈妈去世了吗？

sentences.en: Julie was surprised and asked Cora where she heard such a thing.
sentences.zh: 朱莉感到很惊讶，问科拉是从哪听来的这种话。

sentences.en: Cora replied,
sentences.zh: 科拉回答说：

sentences.en: I've been having dreams about Mummy.
sentences.zh: 我总是梦到妈妈。

sentences.en: I have dreams about her all the time.
sentences.zh: 我一直梦到她。

sentences.en: Mummy said that she's passed on, but she'll still come to see me all the time.
sentences.zh: 妈妈说她已经去世了，但她还是会经常来看我。

sentences.en: Julie said she was unable to answer the question, but reassured Cora that they would keep looking for Daniela no matter what.
sentences.zh: 朱莉说她无法回答这个问题，但安慰科拉说，无论如何他们都会继续寻找丹妮拉。

sentences.en: Although Cora seemed content with understanding that her mother wasn't coming home,
sentences.zh: 虽然科拉似乎能够接受母亲不会回来的事实，

sentences.en: Julie was determined to get answers for the young girl, so she didn't spend her whole life trying to find out the truth of what happened.
sentences.zh: 但朱莉决心为这个小女孩讨个说法，这样她就不用一辈子都在试图弄清事情的真相。

sentences.en: Life went on, with the Julie continuing her efforts to find Daniela by searching online and contacting media outlets, including Casefile.
sentences.zh: 生活还在继续，朱莉继续努力通过网络搜索和联系媒体（包括Casefile）来寻找丹妮拉。

sentences.en: Casefile became involved in the story in December 2018 and had ongoing contact with several of Daniela's family members, friends and associates,
sentences.zh: Casefile于2018年12月介入此案，并与丹妮拉的多位家属、朋友和熟人保持着持续联系，

sentences.en: who provided information that led to the creation of this episode.
sentences.zh: 他们提供了促成这一期节目制作的信息。

sentences.en: In the last week of April 2019, nine and a half months after Daniela went missing an off-duty sergeant for the Mobile Police Department dive team was mapping out areas
sentences.zh: 在2019年4月的最后一周，即丹妮拉失踪九个半月后，莫比尔警察局潜水队的一名休班警士正在萨拉兰德的塞拉湾河绘制区域图，

sentences.en: for training exercises at the Bayou Serra River in Serraland approximately 17 miles north of the Shell gas station where Daniela was last seen
sentences.zh: 准备进行训练演习，该地点距离丹妮拉最后被看到的壳牌加油站以北约17英里。

sentences.en: The Bayou Serra is a long, wide and gentle stream that expands out from the Mobile River.
sentences.zh: 塞拉湾是一条长而宽且水流平缓的河流，由莫比尔河延伸开来。

sentences.en: The main access point to the river is via the Bayou Serra Boat Launch, a public park in a quiet,
sentences.zh: 进入该河的主要通道是通过塞拉湾船只下水处，这是一个位于安静、

sentences.en: residential area that's popular with locals for fishing, boating, swimming and other water activities.
sentences.zh: 住宅区的公共公园，当地人非常喜欢在那里钓鱼、划船、游泳和其他水上活动。

sentences.en: The park is surrounded by tall trees, shrubbery and grass, with a long wooden footbridge extending along the banks of the water.
sentences.zh: 公园四周环绕着高大的树木、灌木丛和草地，水边沿着河岸延伸着一条长长的木制人行桥。

sentences.en: Towards the drop-off of the Bayou Serra public boat launch, where the water reached between 20 and 30 feet deep, the sergeant noticed something unusual.
sentences.zh: 在塞拉湾公共船只下水处的陡坡附近，水深在20到30英尺之间，这名警士注意到了一些不寻常的东西。

sentences.en: He marked the spot using a GPS, recognising it as a training opportunity for the dive team to investigate further.
